svg.text: The detector, shared by all models
the only part that differs between models
the same in all four models
Inside one backbone stage: two mixers
looks across the image, one frame at a time
looks across time, at each position
keeps a memory from frame to frame
new: added after the temporal mixer
its output does not reach the neck,
so a mixer there would have no effect
The small arrow marks what changes from the row above. PureSSM changes the spatial mixer; SpikingSSM changes the temporal one.
Everything else (data, neck, head, loss and training settings) is the same for all four models.
How the spiking readout works (trace from the real code)
at every time step, for each value y from the mixer
add the input; the old total slowly leaks away
fire a spike when m reaches the threshold ϑ
after a spike, take the threshold off m
Training uses a smooth stand-in for the step,
because the step itself gives no slope to learn from.
The running total m over time
Each spike lowers m by one threshold; anything above it is kept.
